dedupe_keys.name: nepal department of health services annual health report 2081 82 health service coverage facility and programme statistics from the national health information system

description: The Annual Health Report is the Nepal Department of Health Services' yearly account of how the public health system performed, drawn mainly from the national health management information system. The 2081/82 edition, covering the Nepali fiscal year 2024/25 and published in June 2026, runs to 374 pages. Its chapters cover each national programme, including maternal and newborn care, and report service coverage, facility readiness, hospital initiatives and health facility statistics, broken down by province and district. The report is free to download as a PDF from the department's website, which also posts daily reports on the health sector's flood response. Caveats: figures are in a long PDF, not a data file, the Nepali fiscal year runs mid-July to mid-July, data quality depends on facility reporting, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national with sub-national breakdowns. Simulation uses: district-level service volumes and facility readiness for health system capacity and disaster resilience studies in Nepal, for example after floods and earthquakes. Related records: the BIPAD portal (platform-bipad-nepal-disaster-information-management-system) holds health facility points and disaster losses to pair with these statistics.
